passage: You probably haven't taken the time to think of all the work that went into creating the shirt on your back. I mean, how hard it could be to create fabric and {{1}}  it into a shirt shape. Don't machines do all that? Well, creating fabric from cotton, which is the most {{2}}  clothing material, is actually a process that involves a lot of water, 2,700 liters per shirt to be {{3}}  . Take a look at the video below from National Geographic for some more mind-blowing  {{4}} about cotton clothing production. Clean water is  {{5}} becoming one of the most sought-after resources in the world. Given how large the  {{6}} and cotton industries are, they take up a lot of our fresh water demands across the world, according to The Huffington Post. The video from National Geographic was created to spread  {{7}} of how environmentally harmful cotton is. But the situation can be made better. Through better water management and farming practices, water usage in cotton production can be cut down by {{8}}  40 percent. Called "Better Cotton", this environmentally conscious product will save millions of liters of water a year simply from {{9}}  the demands of cotton production. Cotton doesn't have to go, since it is, after all, one of the most useful cash crops across the globe. However, as water supplies ,  {{10}} farmers and consumers need to be more conscious of the effect that these products have on the environment as a whole.

blanks.explain: and 并列 + 不定式 to 后接动词原形 把布"缝"成衬衫形状，sew 最准 语境是 create fabric and __(26)__ it into a shirt shape——造出布料再把它"缝"成衬衫形 状，sew（缝制）正是做衣服的标准动作，与 into a shirt shape 搭配自然。 H) mend 义偏"修补"非"制作" mend 是"修补"已破损的东西，这里是从布料"从无到有做成"衬衫，不是修补，方向不符…

the most + 空 + 名词，形容词最高级作定语 棉花是"最常见/产量最大"的衣料，abundant 最贴 句意是棉花作为 the most __(27)__ clothing material——最"丰富、大量"的衣料，与下文 one of the most useful cash crops across the globe 呼应，abundant（丰富的、大量 的）正合"用得最广"之意。 E) exact 搭配不成立 exa…

to be + 空，系动词后作表语 "to be exact"=确切地说，是固定插入语 2,700 liters per shirt to be __(28)__ 在精确数字 2,700 liters 后用 "to be exact"（确切地 说）这一固定表达收尾，exact 修饰前面给出的精确数字，框架直接锁死。 G) intense 义不符且无此搭配 intense 是"强烈的"，"to be intense"在此说不通，也不是固定…

some more + 空 + about，形容词后接名词 承接上句"2,700 升"的数字，statistics=统计数据最贴 前句刚给出 2,700 liters per shirt 这样的数字，叫人去看视频了解"更多令人震惊的数据"， statistics（统计数据）与 mind-blowing、about cotton production 完全吻合。 C) awareness 义为"意识"，且被第 32 空占用 awarene…

is + 空 + becoming，插在系动词与现在分词之间 清洁水"日益"变得抢手，increasingly 表渐变正合 Clean water is __(30)__ becoming one of the most sought-after resources in the world 描述一种正在加剧的趋势，increasingly（越来越、日益地）修饰 becoming 表渐 变，语义贴切。

the + 空 + and cotton industries，定语名词 与 cotton 并列指"纺织业"，textile 正合 the __(31)__ and cotton industries——"纺织与棉花产业"，textile（纺织品/纺织的）和 cotton 同属衣料产业、并列自然，且 textile industry 是固定说法。 D) conscience 义为"良心"，不能与 cotton 并列指产业 conscie…

spread + 空 + of，及物动词后作宾语 "spread awareness of"=传播……意识，固定搭配 spread __(32)__ of how environmentally harmful cotton is——视频是为了"传播对棉花 危害环境的认知"，spread awareness of 是高频固定搭配，awareness（意识、知晓）完 全契合。 D) conscience 形近义异，无此搭配 conscie…

空 + 40 percent，修饰数量的副词 修饰 40 percent 表"将近 40%"，nearly 最贴 cut down by __(33)__ 40 percent 说节水幅度"将近 40%"，nearly（将近、几乎）正是修 饰数字、表示接近某量的标准副词。 F) increasingly 义为"越来越"，不修饰固定数字 increasingly 表"日益、越来越"，描述渐变趋势，不能修饰 40 percent 这样的固定…

介词 from 后接动名词 "减少需求"用 reducing，且现成-ing 形态 save millions of liters of water a year simply from __(34)__ the demands of cotton production——靠"减少"棉花生产的需求来省水，reducing the demands 是地道及物搭 配，且词库直接给的就是-ing 形式，无需变形。 M) shrink 形态需变…
as 从句主语 supplies 后缺谓语 水供应"减少"，shrink 表自身缩减最贴 as water supplies __(35)__, farmers and consumers need to be more conscious 说"随 着水供应减少"，shrink（缩小、减少）正描述供应量自身收缩，与全文"清洁水日益稀 缺"呼应。
